items.title: What remains without a degree Top?

source.label: Frozen cohort and reconstructed gate audit

metricDefinitions.label: Population
metricDefinitions.definition: Exactly 1,000 public base profiles, excluding diagnostic variants and owner-only records.

metricDefinitions.label: Degree Top
metricDefinitions.definition: At least one college or graduate route among the first three supported careers; associate-only routes are excluded.

metricDefinitions.label: Primary queue
metricDefinitions.definition: Each of the 309 models without degree Top is assigned once using the documented priority order.

caveats: These designed simulated profiles are not a representative student sample.
Primary queues are diagnostic categories, not predictions that a follow-up will produce a match.
All previously inspected holdouts remain separate diagnostic groups.

methods.code:
67 + 15 + 9 + 136 + 81 + 1 = 309
309 - 67 = 242 models without a supported degree option anywhere
182 of the 309 also have no supported Top at any education level

items.title: Which recorded follow-ups do not affect matching?

source.label: Frozen question counts and isolated interface probes

metricDefinitions.label: Offered items
metricDefinitions.definition: Seven evidence items were offered 553 times and received 91 grounded positive simulated responses.

metricDefinitions.label: Probe result
metricDefinitions.definition: Each of these seven positive answer inputs leaves researchRows071 output unchanged, while activity and specialist context controls are consumed.

caveats: Probes are isolated interface checks, not additional cohort profiles or invented model interests.
Existing evidence mapping may already use the same source facts; this does not establish that wiring alone would increase frozen-cohort Top counts.

items.title: How strong is the evidence for the new claims and losses?

source.label: Saved claims, exact source facts and case review

metricDefinitions.label: Review scope
metricDefinitions.definition: All 113 additional supported model-career claims across 15 professions and all six models losing Top or degree Top coverage were included.

metricDefinitions.label: Pattern disagreement
metricDefinitions.definition: Seventeen new claims have negative six-theme correlations; eight are highlighted in Top three. One highlighted claim has an unavailable comparison.

metricDefinitions.label: Specialist reclassification
metricDefinitions.definition: Seventeen optometry and 27 Animal Scientist claims lack the newly required specialty context; no frozen profile has a positive vision or farm-production fact.

caveats: This is a systematic rule and provenance review with selected deeper profile judgments, not independent blinded certification or measured career-fit accuracy.
A negative broad correlation does not by itself invalidate a concrete task preference.
Multiple simulated answers may reuse one source fact; they are not independent confirmations.
No live matching, profiles, saved answers, pay or benchmark outcomes changed.
